neighbours.label: the token ' o': split words (o'er, oaths, oboes) and Spanish 'o' (or)
fire: The ship sailed o'er the sea by night.
The soldiers swore loyalty oaths before the king.
Cantaban en primavera o en otoño.
He brought two oboes to the rehearsal.
Puedes ir en coche o en tren.
They took oaths of silence at the abbey.
The eagle flew o'er the hills at dawn.
quiet: The ship sailed across the sea by night.
The soldiers swore to serve before the king.
Cantaban en primavera y en verano.
He brought two flutes to the rehearsal.
Puedes ir en coche hasta el tren.
They took vows of silence at the abbey.
The eagle flew over the hills at dawn.
